author: ValWood
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**


GO:0004325 | protoporphyrin ferrochelatase activity | IEA with IPR028161

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC4D7.06c

* **Description of issue**

Met8 is bifunctional 
GO:0043115 — precorrin-2 dehydrogenase activity
GO:0051266 — sirohydrochlorin ferrochelatase activity

but not protoporphyrin ferrochelatase (EC 4.98.1.1, HemH/FECH), which inserts Fe²⁺ into protoporphyrin IX at the end of heme biosynthesis.
title: InterPro2GO issue: Met8 isn't GO:0004325	 protoporphyrin ferrochelatase activity IEA with IPR028161
